items.title: The normalization of a proper or projective scheme is again proper or projective
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a proper scheme X over a field with normalization morphism nu, the lemma shows that the normalization is proper over the field, and that it is projective when X is projective (statement lines 4949-4956). The proof uses finiteness of the normalization, established in a previous lemma of the same chapter, and then reads off both conclusions: properness because a finite morphism is proper and properness is stable under composition, projectivity because a finite morphism is projective and projectivity is stable under composition (proof lines 4958-4966). The claim is H2: two short chains of cited stability results on top of the finiteness input, with no construction and no step left to the reader.
